title: bot.ability.learning.output
description:
How the bot's practice of a lesson it was taught went.

The bot perceives this as a turn of its own, after the turn it was taught on. learned true: the lesson is now a behavior of the bot (a rule it answers with, or a routine it keeps on its schedule), and the bot may say so in its own words. learned false: the lesson did not take yet, as a person needs more practice; the bot may say that it needs more practice or to be shown again, never why it failed. A turn that perceives this cannot select another lesson.

lesson.description: The lesson as it was taught.
lesson.title: Lesson

behavior.description: The behavior it learned (null when it did not): its name and what it does.
behavior.title: Behavior

participants.description: Who took part in the teaching turn: present on the learning's answer to the cognition, which hands them to the body with the stimulus, and absent in the stimulus the bot perceives [floppy field].

examples.lesson: Whenever I say exactly 'ping', reply with exactly 'pong'.
Remind me to drink water every hour.
